basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 10.' and it opens 'Vers. 10. Irrigabatur, subauditur, a Jordane, sicut est paradisus Domini. Ex hoc discimus'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 10. Irrigabatur, subauditur, a Jordane, sicut est paradisus Domini. Ex hoc discimus paradisum esse terrenum, cui terrena regio comparatur. Haec regio plana erat et campestris, irrigabatur Jordane fluvio, sicut Aegyptus Nilo. Elegitque Lot sibi regionem circa Jordanem, etc. Allegorice Lot cum suis pastoribus typum tenet haereticorum qui relicta veritate ecclesiastici dogmatis eligunt sibi pulchra et humilia, quia non recte de veritate fidei sentiunt, nec ad Deum cum Moyse in montem ascendunt. Sodoma pecus silens interpretatur.
